hyperedges.label: Scan, review, dry run, apply workflow

nodes.label: Options and Configuration File
nodes.rationale: Unknown keys rejected to catch typos; key settings frozen into the plan so the report predicts exactly what apply does

nodes.label: Dry Run
nodes.rationale: Performs every check including byte-by-byte comparison without deleting, revealing skips before anything is touched

nodes.label: Never-touched Items (links, cloud placeholders, trash, system files)
nodes.norm_label: never-touched items (links, cloud placeholders, trash, system files)

nodes.label: scan command (pre-processing)
nodes.rationale: Scan never modifies anything; produces plan.json, report.html, report.csv for review

nodes.label: Version-control Metadata Handling (.svn/.git/.hg/.bzr)
nodes.rationale: Deleting part of a working copy corrupts it and destination pristine copies must never justify a deletion; Git/Hg/Bzr never deleted since they hold full history

nodes.label: FS SpaceMaker
nodes.rationale: Frees disk space without ever losing unique data: deletes source files proven identical on a destination that is never modified

nodes.label: Plan Confirmation Code
nodes.rationale: Ties apply to the exact reviewed plan; apply refuses without it

nodes.label: Pre-deletion Verification Checks
nodes.rationale: Locks both files, byte-by-byte comparison removes collision risk, deletion through the verified handle; any discrepancy keeps the data

nodes.label: SQLite Fingerprint Index (index.sqlite)
nodes.rationale: Windows Search index has no content fingerprint and may be incomplete; own index keyed by absolute path, batched saves for resumability, only speeds planning and never authorises deletion

nodes.label: Three-stage Identity Filter (size, partial, full BLAKE3)
nodes.norm_label: three-stage identity filter (size, partial, full blake3)
nodes.rationale: Only what can match is read: size rules out most, 64 KB partial hash rules out same-size differences, full 256-bit BLAKE3 confirms

nodes.label: Installation Folder and Single Output Set
nodes.norm_label: installation folder and single output set
nodes.rationale: One-off tool so reports/ keeps a single set replaced each scan, except apply-journal.csv which is append-only

nodes.label: Merge Mode
nodes.rationale: Empties the source completely by deleting same-name-same-size files and moving the rest; compares names and sizes only, never content; never replaces destination files (numbered names)

nodes.label: FS SpaceMaker Report Template
nodes.rationale: Self-contained offline page; program replaces __REPORT_DATA__ placeholder with report JSON

nodes.label: Architecture Module Map
nodes.rationale: Rust gives a single native cross-platform executable, no GC, rayon parallelism and SIMD BLAKE3 so the disk is the only bottleneck

nodes.label: Project Knowledge Graph (graphify-out)
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return scoped subgraphs much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep; graph.json rewritten whole on each build so large diffs are expected
